summary: The filing is a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer) enclosing a management information circular, notice of meeting, and proxy forms for Anfield Energy Inc.'s annual general and special meeting scheduled for July 10, 2026. This is a routine proxy solicitation for shareholder votes on ordinary corporate matters such as director elections and auditor appointments. There is no special-situation event like a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, or going-private transaction described. The document solely addresses procedural voting mechanics and logistics, not any extraordinary corporate action.
